speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You presented with hematuria and right flank pain; to narrow down the cause, are you currently experiencing fever, chills, or nausea? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Appearance: Reddish, WBC: 10-20 /HPF, RBC: Too numerous to count, Nitrites: Negative, Leukocyte_Esterase: Positive; Complete_Blood_Count: Within normal limits

speaker: Doctor
text: The urinalysis confirms active urinary bleeding with significant inflammation (positive leukocyte esterase, WBCs, and RBCs), though nitrites are negative. Since your full blood count is normal, do you have a history of kidney stones or recent trauma to that right side? REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Kidney_Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and the current presence of WBCs with negative nitrites, do you experience burning during urination or urgency? REQUEST TEST: Renal Function Panel. REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Kidney_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Renal Function Panel: Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL, BUN: 14 mg/dL, Complete_Blood_Count: Within normal limits; Right_Kidney_Ultrasound: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound reveals multiple cysts in the medulla of your right kidney, which combined with your recurrent infections and hematuria is highly suggestive of Medullary Cystic Kidney Disease or Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease. To confirm if these cysts are causing obstruction or if there is any underlying malignancy, I need to visualize the structure more closely; do you have any family history of kidney disease, and would you agree to the imaging review? REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Kidney_CT_Scan_with_contrast.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Hematuria and right flank pain. I also have History of recurrent urinary tract infections, No recent trauma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD). The ultrasound findings of multiple medullary cysts in a patient with recurrent UTIs and hematuria are pathognomonic for this condition, distinguishing it from simpler cysts seen in other renal pathologies.
